random_short_side_scale_jitter: apply random short side scale jittering to a tensor of video frames between min and max size
random_crop: perform a random spatial crop on a tensor of images to a specified square size
horizontal_flip: apply horizontal flip augmentation to a tensor of images with a given probability
color_jitter: apply brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter augmentation to a tensor of BGR images
RandomResizedCropAndInterpolation: create a PIL image transform that performs random resized crop with configurable scale, ratio, and interpolation
